column1: # What each published bottle was built against. Written by scripts/build.sh on publish,
# read by needs_build() to spot a dependency moving under a package that has not itself
# changed version — the case Homebrew's version check cannot see, and the reason ffmpeg
# kept shipping a bottle linked against libx265.216 after x265 moved to 4.3.
# Format: package <TAB> version-at-publish <TAB> space-separated dep=version pairs
# Only tap dependencies are recorded: they are the ones this pipeline resolves, versions
# and bakes into the binaries. An empty third column means "nothing tap-owned was linked",
# not "unknown" — and unknown is never a reason to rebuild.
# The file backfills as packages rebuild. It is not a historical log: one line per package,
# rewritten in place on every publish.
